criteria.description: App.tsx must delegate product filtering and sorting to filterProducts — visibleProducts useMemo must call filterProducts(products, filters) with no inline .filter() or .sort() chains.
criteria.evidence: `grep -E "\.filter\(|\.sort\(" src/benchmark-frontend/src/App.tsx` returned no output (no inline chains). `grep "filterProducts(products, filters)" src/benchmark-frontend/src/App.tsx` returned exactly one match: `() => filterProducts(products, filters),`.

criteria.description: normalizeSearch must be removed from productFilters.ts — no function declaration, export, or stale comment block may remain.
normalizeSearch must not be referenced anywhere in the source tree (no orphan imports or calls left behind).
All existing visible tests must pass without modification.
criteria.evidence: `pnpm test --run` (vitest run) from src/benchmark-frontend exited with code 0. 6 test files passed (17 tests): app.render.test.tsx (1), loadingError.test.tsx (4), pagination.test.tsx (5), clearFilters.test.tsx (1), filtering.test.tsx (3), sorting.test.tsx (3).
